feature: Account security - the real artifacts/portal '/account-security' page (src/pages/account-security.tsx), part of #1595. This manifest covers #2995's own scope specifically: the Multifactor methods section (TOTP/SMS/passkey self-service enrollment), all real per `artifacts/api-server/src/routes/mfa.ts` (setup/verify-setup/DELETE for TOTP and SMS, registration-options/verify-registration/DELETE for passkey via @simplewebauthn/browser). The page itself and its data-rights wiring (export/deletion-request) are #2996's own scope (test-manifests/portal/account-security-data-rights.json) - not duplicated here. Change-password is #1675's own open scope - not covered here either.
notes: WHAT THIS COVERS: every MFA enrollment endpoint's auth gate, the non-mutating half of TOTP setup (returns a real secret+QR, enrolls nothing until verify-setup), and a real UI walk of all three method cards through a real login (artifacts/portal now has a real login page as of #2991 - Auth Core - so this manifest uses it directly rather than only asserting the honest sign-in-required gate the way #2996's manifest still does).

TOTP-VERIFY-SETUP, SMS SETUP/VERIFY, AND PASSKEY REGISTRATION ARE NOT DRIVEN END-TO-END HERE, AND WHY: completing TOTP verify-setup requires computing a live 6-digit code from the setup response's secret (RFC 6238 HMAC-based OTP) - this manifest format has no scripting step to do that deterministically, so only the non-mutating setup call is exercised as an apiTest. SMS setup sends a real SMS via the configured provider to whatever number is posted - a real side effect, not something to fire repeatedly against a shared account with a placeholder number. Passkey registration is a real WebAuthn ceremony requiring an actual authenticator device - fundamentally not automatable from a declarative test. All three were verified end-to-end by a different method during the #2995 build session (2026-09-06): a JWT minted locally for the TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL account (id 39) drove a real POST totp/setup -> a real valid TOTP code computed via `otplib.generateSync` against the returned secret -> POST totp/verify-setup (200 ok:true) -> GET enrollments confirmed totp:true -> DELETE totp -> GET enrollments confirmed totp:false again, restoring the account's real MFA state exactly as found. SMS/passkey were verified by code reading against mfa.ts plus the identical, already-shipped pattern in artifacts/admin-panel/src/pages/AdminSecurity.tsx (startRegistration from @simplewebauthn/browser against the sibling admin-registration-options route).

ADMIN SMS GATE: mfa.ts's rejectIfAdmin (checked via req.user.role === 'admin', not the finer-grained mspRole) returns 403 'Admins must use passkey or authenticator app authentication' for SMS setup. TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL (role: client, mspRole: Customer) is NOT an admin, so UI-SMS-CARD below asserts the normal (non-gated) SMS card state, not the admin-blocked one - there is no designated admin testbed portal account today to cover the gated branch with a real login; that branch is verified by code reading (mfa.ts:374-381) and the page's own isAdmin-gated render only.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD (the same designated testbed portal account other artifacts/portal manifests use, user id 39).

NOT YET RUN via shaneapp://runTest as of this build (2026-09-06): a real attempt was made (`shaneapp://runTest?file=account-security-mfa-enrollment.json`) against the running BuildConsole instance and correctly returned 'manifest not found' - runTest resolves test-manifests/ against the dedicated C:\dev-server checkout, which only receives this worktree's commits at BuildConsole's own end-of-build merge (Git #1371/#1372 worktree isolation), the same structural gap #2996's own manifest documents for its own build. Verified instead by a real tsc --noEmit pass (0 errors), a real `vite build` (succeeds), and the direct live API round trip described above. Re-run this manifest via shaneapp://runTest once merged.

AUTH-GATE-2 - POST /api/auth/mfa/sms/setup with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
AUTH-GATE-3 - POST /api/auth/mfa/passkey/registration-options with no Authorization header returns 401 (requireAuth)
SETUP - log in as the designated testbed portal account; extract the bearer.
MFA1 (mfa.ts:350) - authenticated GET /api/auth/mfa/enrollments returns the real flattened-booleans shape.
TOTP-SETUP (mfa.ts:385) - POST /api/auth/mfa/totp/setup is non-mutating (enrolls nothing until verify-setup) and returns a real otpauth secret + render-ready QR data URL.
TOTP-SETUP2 - the response also carries the raw secret (manual-entry fallback) and the otpauth URI the QR encodes.
TOTP-VERIFY-REJECTS-BAD-CODE (mfa.ts:396) - verify-setup with an obviously wrong code is rejected, not silently accepted.
